title: File:Detlev-Rohwedder-Haus front.jpg
desc: Nowadays the German Ministry of Finance, this building served as the German Air Force building during World War II and as a DDR administrative building. It's top mural portrays the ideal of the communist society, while the artwork below portrays it's horrors.
